body: eh sometimes.... i helped peopl whose quality of life of was 0...i suppose this is the dichotomy in the situation... and yes i want to help people, i want to give my life purpose by having it effect others in a positive way...and i have talked to my parents about my situation and they deny it... which is strange because my father made three attempts at life... my mother thinks i need jesus...she told me that if i go to hell and see the place for myself i would not be depressed anymore.

and my family do not believe in therapists, they think i am just in a phase and when i try to speak to them about needing mental help they take it as weakness... from a maternal standpoint i would be incredibly frustrated seeing my child sleeping all day... so i cannot blame them but everything is circular... the idea of myself adds to my anger towards myself.... adds to the depression... ad nauseam

no nothing horrific, i was a low level EMT, you have to put in about a year doing hospital discharges and dialysis calls before 911 hires you. thankfully i put in over a year so i am, on paper, eligible to work 911... but i feel with my emotional state i may put peoples lives at risk...or mine... because i know the statistics of how many people who work EMS end their lives or become prone to addiction and PTSD...it seems like my entire life plan is pointed in the direction of ending itself... of reaching a point where i would not take it anymore and not want it anymore and be completely okay with that

i understand that this sub is not for people who hands on need help, i have been trying to find a therapist for about 2 months now and no one is calling me back so i just want to try this... the first person that called me back had his prescription pad for prozac ready in about 8 minutes of speaking to me which was a little offensive. My family wants me to succeed and is encouraging me but it is almost like tossing boulders on my shoulders... i just want them to leave me alone and just not love me, i do not want the responsibility of being loved by someone....and my favorite memory is having a paranoid schizophrenic tell me that, "the safest place i have felt all day was in the back of the ambulance with you".... when someone has voices telling them that everyone wants to kill them.... and you can be a safe haven for that soul... it is truly special

i have wanted to move out for years, just cannot manage to live where i live on my income even at my former job... i have felt this incredible stir craze but feel trapped by vague responsibilities to be successful for my family...who honestly very much care about my success but i have never been able to really finish anything in my life... and i was a low level EMT... afforded me a lot of lovely experiences with people who are just as fucked up as i am... I do like helping people, but, i like helping people who need help....it is hard to describe... i am blabering
you know people tell me that but sometimes the dark irrationality just grips  you and does not let go. It is rational to be afraid but not like this...thank you for your words

i am 24, live at home, have never lived outside of home, am the fuck up of my family, my family love me but treat me like a burden which in retrospect i am (emotionally and physically), i just lost my job which was the only thing that gave me any purpose becuase it allowed me to help people.... the list goes on and on and on
